text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spring Classics. We held back on the intense training for them.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby. Unable to resist the once-in-a-lifetime temptation,
the outcome was—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...It was wise not to force a win.
Though, not entering the race in the first place was also an option, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you must make up for that reckless display
with your treatment.
Administer the nutritional supplements in this order: 3a, 8b, and 6d_2.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "After that, absolute bed rest for three days. Well, as long as you moderate your training like you said, you should pull through just fine."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if you were going to apologize,
you should have just stopped yourself from the start.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing it's out of reach, we still run.
Humans and Umamusume are no different in that regard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to some devoted aftercare, her condition didn't take a major turn for the worse, and our hopes carry on into the autumn..."
